annotations.text:
DuelBox — website and in-game GUI.

Cartoon cast, professional layout. Pip (coral) is player one and Bo (sky) is player two; they appear on every screen so the product has a face before a thumbnail loads.

The 3D arcade hero and the character sheet are on the Concept page.

Ours, not a copy: our own two-character cast rather than generic red/blue tokens, a browse page with search, categories and sort instead of one unbroken scroll, coloured player bars on the screen edges instead of rotated score pills, and a dealt-hand tournament rather than a node track.

The arcade room is one 3D scene: tables float at different depths on a shared vanishing point and the camera walks you to the one you pick. Built as CSS 3D here to settle the composition; production would be Three.js on the landing route only, never in a game bundle.

Motion is decoration — every tile is legible standing still, and reduced-motion or a low-end device gets the flat catalogue with no WebGL downloaded at all.
